title: 75 on screen: a data snapshot and the data itself are different things
goal: Prepare a readable report and reconcile its facts while respecting edition limits.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P8. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A spreadsheet document shows 75 minutes. It looks presentable, but are the original 30 and 45 preserved? How do you distinguish a legitimate zero from an empty cell? Check values separately from their presentation.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Your copy and separate files
paragraphs: Continue your own P8 copy. Close Enterprise, save a DT backup and restore it into a new empty infobase; verify the actual path. Preserve prior work, records and the handler. Do not load a full CF over your work.

НовыйНаборРегистров creates new training records owned by this experiment. Preserve the previous handler first. Remove only the added startup call after one run, so reopening does not create another set. Compare your own references rather than the screenshot’s UUIDs.

sections.title: Presentation is not the source of truth
paragraphs: A print form presents selected data state; it does not replace source documents or modify them for formatting. State generation time, number, customer, units and total. Later source changes do not automatically update an older exported snapshot.

Label the own 30/45 set with customer key, period and minutes. A spreadsheet document displays results but does not become the accounting source. Do not parse formatted/rounded text back into subsequent calculations.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеОтчёты common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The function builds a snapshot of two own requests and returns that same spreadsheet document with its checks. The client displays actual references, 30, 45, and a 75-minute total. Subsequent reference reads retain the original minutes. Display is not claimed as printing or export.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Number and formatting differ
paragraphs: Displaying 600.00 does not turn text into a number or define rounding. Compute under the contract before formatting for locale. Test long names, line wrapping and zero totals. A visually empty cell must not stand for a legitimate zero without an explicit rule.

Reconcile references and 2/75 before inspecting order, headings, long synthetic names and zero versus missing. For monetary examples, rounding belongs to the module 3 calculation contract; formatting belongs to presentation.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: After building a snapshot without saving the source requests, what should remain in the infobase?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: 30 and 45. A spreadsheet document is a separate presentation of read data. The 75 total is not a command to update each source document.

sections.title: Edition controls availability
paragraphs: Training edition restricts runtime spreadsheet-document printing/saving. Check the exact build and official terms rather than promising every client an export. Use another permitted original reconciliation protocol where needed. Do not bypass limits with patches or call a screenshot a proven document export.

Open the own report and Generate. If the official edition permits Print/Save, use standard preview and a separate result file. Training editions may restrict this: record unavailability and reconcile on screen without bypassing limits.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The snapshot saves no source document. The worked client displays the same object checked by the function. New 20/0 data distinguish zero from blank in the independent task. Printing and export remain separate, unverified actions.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: A zero formatted as blank can be mistaken for missing data. Text “0” can also be mistaken for a numeric value. The new task checks the cell’s numeric value, its displayed text, and a genuinely empty neighbouring cell separately.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Test by rereading output
paragraphs: In a permitted environment, generate, save by a supported route and reopen. Reconcile identities, units and totals, not merely file existence. If unavailable, explain clearly and preserve source data. Native generation, physical printing and export require distinct evidence.

Reread requests and confirm report viewing changed no durations. Retain only synthetic screenshots and command availability with version. Missing print support neither validates a wrong total nor makes Sandbox mandatory.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create a spreadsheet snapshot for new own requests of 20 and 0 minutes. Check total 20, numeric zero in the second request’s row, visible text 0, and an empty cell in the following row. Reread the sources: 20 and 0 must remain. Do not parse formatted text back into calculations or print the document for this task.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Distinguish generating a snapshot, displaying it, actual printing, and exporting. Establishing one does not establish the others.
